PRINCIPAL RAE 


FROM THE INFORMATION OFFICE 
Vi. h-013) Local 130 
GERALD WRIGHT DIRECTOR 


RES UNIVERSITY FEES 


METROPOLITAN YMCA 
OF MONTREAL 


SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS 
UNIVERSITY AND SCHOOLS 


June 17, 1963 


The Star would like to get a statement 
from us on fees as a follow up to the recent 


announcement of other universities. 


Our increase is not a large one and we could 
use this as a chance to state plainly our 
financial efficiency in comparison to most 
other universities with day and night op- 
eration and the highest proportion self 
sustaining. We could also point out that 

we manage all this in spite of the inequity 
of the present formula for student provincial 


grants.
